questions.text: A snail climbs a 10-metre wall: 3 metres up each day, sliding 2 metres back each night. On which day does it reach the top?
questions.why: The snail gains 1 m a day, so after 7 nights it's at 7 m and climbs the last 3 m on day 8.

questions.text: A bag has 5 red and 5 blue socks. In the dark, how many must you take to be sure of a matching pair?
questions.why: There are only two colours, so any 3 socks must include two of the same colour.

questions.text: Starting at 12:00, how many times do a clock's hour and minute hands meet in 12 hours, counting 12:00 once?
questions.why: The minute hand laps the hour hand every 12/11 hours, so they meet 11 times in 12 hours.

questions.text: What English word retains the same pronunciation even after you take away four of its five letters?
questions.why: Take U, E, U and E away from QUEUE and the Q that's left is still pronounced "queue".
